remarks:
Attention outdoor lovers and investors! Nestled on 9.7 wooded acres filled with hard maple, cherry, and beech trees, this unique property offers the ultimate four-season getaway. Explore scenic trails right on your land or snowmobile directly across the street with access to over 2,000 acres of the Canadaway Creek Nature Conservancy. Enjoy nearby Earl Cardot Trails, and Cassadaga Lake- just minutes away.
The updated 4-bedroom, 1.5 bath main home features an open floor plan with a cozy corner wood-burning stove, French doors leading to a 50x10 covered rear deck with bar, and an enclosed hot tub room—perfect for relaxing after a day outdoors. The kitchen offers a beautiful black walnut breakfast bar, and numerous updates make this home move-in ready.
Beyond the main residence, this property is being operated as a Bed & Breakfast. This includes SEVEN rental cabins, a primitive and modern outhouse, new out door shower, offering a fantastic short-term rental or group retreat opportunity. A large gazebo, multiple fire pits, grill areas, and playsets create the perfect setting for gatherings and outdoor enjoyment.
Located near snowmobile trails, public hunting and fishing lands, Lily Dale Assembly, Chautauqua County Wine Trail, the Amish Trail, Lake Erie, and SUNY Fredonia—less than 10 miles from NYS Thruway, with Buffalo, Erie, and Niagara Falls just over an hour away.
Whether you’re looking for a recreational retreat, an income-producing property, or a place to live and play year-round, this one-of-a-kind property has it all!
